---
name: gaming-stack
description: "Use when designing or testing Gate-OS gaming integration: Proton, Wine, GameMode, MangoHud, controllers, emulators, and GPU profiles."
---

## Procedure
Classify proprietary clients as user-downloaded; package only redistributable components; define on-demand startup, resource profile, controller mapping, GPU support, and rollback. Measure on named hardware with a reproducible workload.

## Verification
Manifest validates, images/dependencies are pinned and licensed, controller/GPU matrix is documented, and performance claims are evidence-backed or labeled targets.
